description: Represents a form: label/value pairs, fill-in fields, or a declaration/application layout, preserved as structured content rather than a data table or running prose.
applicability: The page contains form fields, label:value pairs, checkboxes, or fill-in blanks.
The content is laid out as a form (a template to be completed) rather than a data grid or operative prose.
instructions: Keep each label together with its value/field; never separate a label from its value into different blocks.
Represent a coherent form section as one block, or as a parent block with its fields as children, preserving field order.
A form may contain an embedded bordered grid (e.g. a blank fill-in matrix or a question/answer block); keep that grid as PART of the form, not as a separate table.
Do not merge unrelated form sections into one block, and do not model a fill-in form as a data table (use the table skill only for standalone grids with populated, homogeneous data rows).

A form that is itself the body of a schedule/appendix (its cover title was handled as document furniture) is that schedule's payload, NOT an operative rule: attach it under the schedule cover heading (parent_block_id = that heading), never as a top-level text_block or numbered point.
